selectedRateSource.title: ChatGPT Rate Card (Enterprise token-based pricing)
selectedRateSource.section: ChatGPT Work and Codex models; Additional fees and multipliers; GPT-6 Astra — Codex long-context exception
selectedRateSource.paraphrasedFacts: The public card covers new Enterprise agreements specifying USD usage billing; agreement terms determine applicable pricing. Astra Codex lists $10 fresh input, $1 cached input and $50 output per million tokens. Available reasoning levels share rates. Astra Codex has no additional long-context multiplier and Codex has no cache-write charge. Fast mode and regional processing can add multipliers; feature fees may apply.

assumptions: All recorded gpt-6-astra settings identify the executing model; settings are from turn_context, not response-verified model identities.
Standard speed; no regional-processing uplift. These are selected scenario assumptions, not observed billing settings.
Use the rate card retrieved on 2026-09-06 as a comparison scenario. Effective start/end dates and historical applicability are unavailable.
Input includes cached input. Reasoning is already included in output. Cache-write tokens are zero in this snapshot and no additional fee is applied.
exclusions: Separate tool/feature fees are excluded and unknown; not assumed zero.
Hidden, unobserved or later usage is excluded and unknown. This is a frozen partial run.
No contract discounts, credits, commitments, taxes, subscription allocation or invoice reconciliation.
rounding: None: rates yield integral nanoUSD per token
pricingMapping: fresh=input-cached; cached=cached; output includes reasoning; no extra cache-write fee
